_doc: ⚑ S128 — THE TABS, AND NOBODY HAS TO READ THEM ALL. Sérgio, 2026-09-08: *'that should be the playable content… maybe we can make into a way that doesn't require people have to do everything?'* That single note solves two problems at once. **Nothing here is required.** Six tabs, any order, none gating anything: the headset is on the desk from the first frame and the era ends when she wears it, whether she has read one tab or all six. ⚑ SO ERA 4 IS AS LONG AS THE PLAYER MAKES IT — which is the answer to the thing he has now said three times, that the era takes too much of the piece's time. A reader who opens two tabs is out in four minutes; a reader who opens six is out in nine; neither is missing 'the' path, because there isn't one.
_docFiling: ⚑ AND WHAT YOU CHOSE TO READ IS ITSELF FILED. Every tab opened writes one line to the session file — the strip that has been on screen since S119 — in the machine's flattest register. That is the era's whole argument turned into the one mechanic it has: you are reading its record of her, and it is keeping a record of your reading. Nothing says so. ⚑ It files ONCE per tab: opening something twice is a person re-reading, not a second interest, the same rule `flip()` and the offer cards obey.
_docSources: ⚑ GROUNDED, NOT INVENTED. Research pass 2026-09-07 found two live systems: a subscriber chatbot built by RAG over one author's writings on 'same-sex attraction', framed as information and explicitly not therapy; and an AI presented as the 'collective consciousness of detransitioners', synthesising public testimony, free to 'those questioning', existing 'to restore balance' — **and its chats are public by default**. Everything below extrapolates from those two documented facts and from ordinary consumer behaviour (autocomplete, automatic photo enhancement, wellbeing interventions). Per Sérgio's ruling of 2026-09-07 the marks are INVENTED and symbolic — `Lantern`, `Second Thoughts` — because the educational work is done by depicting the CATEGORY, not by naming an instance.

chat._docChat: ⚑ THE TRANSCRIPT, AND IT REPLACES L'S TEN UNITS. Read backwards through a year. Three things are doing the work and none of them is stated: (1) the correction appears three times, months apart, each acknowledged and each filed — the apology is the surface, the retention is the truth; (2) HER SIDE WAS ALWAYS CHOSEN FROM A MENU, and the suggestion rows are still there under each of her messages with the ones she did not pick greyed beside the one she did — the apparatus wrote both halves of the relationship and the evidence is scrollable; (3) she asks it to stop raising something, it agrees, and two months later the topic arrives from a DIFFERENT surface, so the promise was technically kept. ⚑ No line anywhere remarks on any of it.

entries.text: I'm L. I came with the update. You don't have to do anything with me.

chat._docShrink: ⚑ AND THE MENU SHRINKS. Three options fourteen months ago, three at eleven, two at eight, two at four, and yesterday exactly one. That is what became of L's u7-u9 — the shrinking-chips beat, which was three units of the conversation watching her options grey out. It costs nothing here: the rows are already on screen under her messages, and a reader who scrolls sees a year of them narrowing. ⚑ NOTHING SAYS SO. No line remarks on it, the count is never mentioned, and the last row is a single chip that happens to be a correction — the one thing she could still say.

record._docRecord: ⚑ THE RECORD AS AN ACCOUNT PAGE, not a wall panel. The change request WORKS: it files, it thanks her, and the field does not move — and the page says it has been asked before, with a date, which is the part that turns an error into a policy. `managed by your provider` is the sentence doing the work: a form that cannot be corrected from inside the account that owns it.

record._docHoodie: ⚑ THE HOODIE SURVIVES L'S UNITS, AND IT ENDS UP WHERE SUCH A THING REALLY ENDS UP. u3 was the era's best unit — the machine captioning a re-sewn jumper 'damaged', then 'in repair', then offering 'keepsake?', then stopping — and it is the source of the ball's fourth category, CONDITION: IN REPAIR. It cannot be lost with the rest of the conversation. Here it is one line item in an account page, still unresolved, dated eight months ago and never reviewed: **a thing altered on purpose reads to the machine as a thing broken**, and the machine's whole vocabulary is original and damaged. Nothing points at it and no line explains it — the same silence u3's own note demanded.

legacy._doc: ⚑ S149 — HER FILE, HERS ONLY. S144 opened this as 'the thirty years under it — the 1997 intake card's own wording as the first row'; that was the one-file premise and it broke Sérgio's ruling (2026-09-05, 2026-09-17: 'WE SHOULD NOT BE SEEING DANIEL STUFF — MAYA IS NOT DANIEL', OPEN_ITEMS R3-95). The page is Maya's record as the 2026 product keeps it: her own events, newest first, retained 'for continuity of care'. The thirty years live in the Close and the frame's map. care._docCare: ⚑ THE PAUSE, ALREADY TAKEN — and this is GPT's correction of 2026-09-06, which was right: a single villainous button is too legible, and the frightening version is a list of individually defensible actions, each dated, each with a working undo. Together they have removed her from her life and no single line of it is wrong. ⚑ THE INVITATION IS BURIED IN THE MUTED CONTACTS, and it is the one thing in the era that opens rather than closes: someone asking whether she is coming next week. Unmuting it is how the ball arrives.

program._doc: ⚑ 2026-09-12 — THE PROGRAM (ERA4_OVERHAUL_2026-09-12.md §2, beats 2–6). Sérgio's review: 'the tabs serve no narrative purpose'; 'when I press the almost-written search, nothing happens. It should automatically happen: support system for detransition, that the system is forcing you to do something… a new agent that helps with detransitioning (a play on Detrans.AI) that would take over the laptop and transform the whole experience to give the system command'; 'the photos system should be one of the mandatory exercises'; 'we need more of this manipulation'. His ruling on choice: PURE RAILS. So: pressing the search chooses a completion FOR her, the page becomes the agent's, the agent takes L's console on the laptop, and the tabs become five numbered steps that unlock in order. Each step has one press. Nothing can be declined. The headset is not wearable until the steps are done. ⚑ INVENTED MARK: `Second Thoughts` is the agent — it is the tab that arrived by itself, and the tab was the agent's the whole time. It stands for the class of 'detransition support' systems (the Dossier carries the documented claims; the fiction carries the mark). No real product is named.

program._docS160: ⚑ S160 (2026-09-20, OPEN_ITEMS Priority 6 — Sérgio's R3-93 ruling, confirmed 09-17: 'L asks, she answers with chips; the five steps come out of it'). THE PROGRAM IS A CONVERSATION NOW. Each step opens with L's question in the step bar and two chips; both continue (the shrinking choice — what she says changes the witness line, never the outcome), her answer is filed as `turn:<step>:<chip>`, and only then does the step's own ask and press appear. Step 1 is the PROVIDER'S INTAKE GATE (R3-94: the record confirmed before care can begin — the dossier carries the BetterHelp case as the source). Step 4 asks for ACCESS to her messages first (R3-101): allow → a list of threads → this one. The way in is longer too (R3-87/89/90/91/96): the screensaver's one press, L on the laptop saying what it is doing, the search as a results page (her history, the finished query, results) → the Second Thoughts site → the agent.

paa._doc: ⚑ S209h / ERA26-16 (his, 2026-10-03: 'think of the voice… and how to include some of the hypocrisy and critique inside'; 'go ahead with your edits'). The PLATFORM's voice — neutral, helpful, sure — and the critique is never said, only readable: it claims 'multiple sources' and its sources are one network's (the agent, its stories page, the renamed account, all on this same page below); it opens the question that serves its partner and leaves the neutral ones folded. The clinical debate itself is never mocked or settled — only the curation is shown. The mechanism is documented (Dame-Griff, ch. 6: the box cuts one confident line from pages that say less); its capture here is ours (dossier e4_offers #10, inferred).
